description: A 32-step sequencer whose sliders set the probability that each step fires, and whose slider heights also make a pitch

params.text: Returns the sequence to its first step
Picks one of nine preset slider patterns
Throws every slider to a new random probability
Replaces every slider's probability with one minus it
Halves the pattern and repeats it, each press halving what is left
Sets the number of steps played before the sequence returns to the start, 1 to 32
Scales the pitch taken from the slider heights, 0 to 100% of the full voltage range
Sets the root note that the pitch outputs are quantised to
Picks the scale the pitch outputs are quantised to, among them the Messiaen modes of limited transposition and the seventh chords

inputs.text: A gate throws every slider to a new random probability
A gate replaces every slider's probability with one minus it
A gate halves the pattern and repeats it
A clock advances the sequence by one step
A trigger returns the sequence to its first step
Selects one of twelve memory banks from the fractional part of the voltage, so a pitch voltage picks a bank by its semitone

outputs.text: Fires 10V when the sequence reaches that step and its slider wins its probability roll
Fires 10V at a step whose slider wins its probability roll
Fires 10V at a step whose slider loses its probability roll
Carries the current step's slider height subtracted from full scale, quantised to the root note and scale
Carries a pitch from the height of the current step's slider, quantised to the root note and scale, whether or not that step fired

notes: click or drag across the sliders to draw a pattern, and click a memory bank to recall or store one
the sequencer has no clock of its own: nothing advances until a clock arrives at the CLK input.
menu: Gate mode — Gates, which last the step, or Triggers, which are 1ms long
V/OCT mode — Independent changes the pitch at every step, Sample and Hold changes it only when a gate fires
Volt Offset — takes the pitch from a -5V to +5V range, or from a 0-10V range
Slider Percentages — prints the probability on each slider
Keyboard Shortcuts — turns on ctrl with the left and right arrows to shift the sliders sideways, and ctrl with the up and down arrows to move them by 5%
